keyword: who puts the green jacket on a back to back winner

verifications.claim: When a player wins the Masters in consecutive years, the Augusta National Golf Club Chairman puts the green jacket on them rather than the previous year's winner.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'The last two times there was a repeat champion, with Nick Faldo in 1990 and Tiger Woods in 2002, the club’s chairman assisted with the jacket.'; R2: 'the Augusta National Golf Club chairman to put the jacket on him. This was the case in 2002... Hootie Johnson... 1990... Hord Hardin'; R4: 'When Nick Faldo (in 1990), Tiger Woods (in 2002), and Rory McIlroy (in 2026) repeated as champions, the chairman of Augusta National put the jacket on them.'; R5: 'Tournament traditions call for the club's chairman... to put the jacket (back) on the defending champion.'
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources directly state that for repeat winners (except the first in 1966), the chairman puts on the jacket instead of the previous winner, establishing this as the tradition.
